Question:
Let \(h_n\) and \(k_n\) be the unique relatively prime positive integers such that

\[\frac11+\frac12+\frac13+\cdots+\frac1n=\frac{h_n}{k_n}.\]

Let \(L_n\) denote the least common multiple of the numbers \(1,\) \(2,\) \(3,\) \(\ldots,\) \(n.\) For how many integers \(n\) with \(1\le n\le22\) is \(k_n\lt L_n?\)
